topic: The Brachistochrone Problem: The Race of Curves

sections.title: Defining the Mystery
lecture_lines: The Brachistochrone problem seeks the fastest descent curve.
Distance is short, but gravity dictates speed.
Imagine a marble rolling down three different tracks.
animations: Fade in title: Defining the Mystery.
Display a point A and B represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/marble.svg].
Animate a smooth path connecting the two marble [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/marble.svg] assets.

sections.title: Prerequisite Intuition: Energy vs. Time
lecture_lines: A straight line is not the quickest path.
Steep drops build kinetic energy early.
We must balance distance against speed gain.
animations: Fade in title: Prerequisite Intuition: Energy vs. Time.
Show conservation of energy equation: 1/2mv^2 = mgh with a falling [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg].
Highlight v = sqrt(2gh) to show velocity relationship for the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg].

sections.title: The Mathematical Reveal: The Cycloid
lecture_lines: The optimal solution is a cycloid curve.
It traces a point on a rolling wheel.
Parametric equations define this elegant trajectory.
Wheel rotation generates the path visually.
Cycloids minimize travel time between points.
animations: Fade in title: The Mathematical Reveal: The Cycloid.
Draw a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wheel.svg] rolling to trace a cycloid path.
Overlay cycloid path on the A to B grid.

sections.title: The 'Brachistochrone' Principle in Action
lecture_lines: Why does the cycloid win the race?
Flat sections leverage that high velocity.
animations: Fade in title: The 'Brachistochrone' Principle in Action.
Compare cycloid with linear and circular paths.
Flash the cycloid to emphasize shortest time path.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Nature often chooses the path of least time.
The cycloid outperforms the straight path.
animations: Fade in title: Summary and Conclusion.
Show final text: Nature optimizes time.
